info.name: FilmLog Movie Watchlist API
info.description: Postman collection for the local FilmLog Laravel API. Import the matching environment and run the collection from top to bottom. The collection is designed to run repeatedly without resetting the database: every run registers a new user, so watchlist and review data do not collide.

request.description: Utility endpoint. Returns {"status":"ok"}. It is not part of the starter API contract.

response.name: 200 OK
